questions.stem_latex:
A continuous random variable, $X$, has the following probability density function.

$$f(x) = \begin{cases} k\cos\left(\dfrac{\pi x}{2}\right) & 0 \le x \le 1 \\ 0 & \text{otherwise} \end{cases}$$

parts.label: a
parts.latex: Show that $k = \dfrac{\pi}{2}$

parts.label: b
parts.latex: Find $P\left(X < \dfrac{1}{2} \mid X < \dfrac{2}{3}\right)$

parts.label: c
parts.latex: Find the median of $X$.

solutions.latex: Look at where $f'(x) < 0$ (i.e. where the curve is below the $x$-axis)

$y = 5x - 3$ translated 2 units left and 1 unit up will give

$y = \big(5(x+2) - 3\big) + 1 \Rightarrow y = 5x + 8$

The graph is made up of two lines, the portion from $x = 0$ to $x = 2$ is $y = -x + 2$ and the portion from $x = 2$ to $x = 4$ is $y = x - 2$.

Option A would produce an area of 0 by adding the negative triangle and positive triangle formed by $y = x - 2$.

Option B would produce the same result as option A.

Option C would give a correct area in absolute value by doubling the area of the triangle formed by $y = x - 2$ from $x = 0$ to $x = 2$, but it would produce a negative answer.

Option D would give a correct area by doubling the area of the triangle formed by $y = x - 2$ from $x = 0$ to $x = 2$ and cancelling the negative. (This is the correct answer.)

$-1 < r < 1$ for series to have a limiting sum

$r = 1 - \dfrac{x}{2}$

$-1 < 1 - \dfrac{x}{2} < 1$

$-2 < -\dfrac{x}{2} < 0$

$4 > x > 0$

$\therefore\ 0 < x < 4$

notes: Cover says 'In Questions 11 – 37' but the paper ends at Q34 (Section II Q11-34, 90 marks); printed page numbers skip 6, 10, 14, 18, 26. Q16 (a,b,c differentiations) and Q19 (a,b integrals) are unrelated parts and are stored as 16(a)-(c) and 19(a)-(b), with src_label kept. The bundled 'Questions and solutions' pages (idx 24-36) are from a different version of the paper: MCQs are numbered 1-20 in a different order and several items (sol Q1, 2, 8, 11, 12, 15, 17, 20) are not in this paper, so only the matching items were extracted and mapped to this paper's numbers: sol Q3->Q1, Q4->Q2, Q5->Q3, Q6->Q4, Q7->Q5, Q13->Q6, Q14->Q7, Q16->Q8, Q18->Q9, Q19->Q10; sol Q10 working -> Q18 (short answer here); sol Q9 working -> Q24 (a: Venn crop, b: P(B|A)); sol 'Q20 KL' -> Q20; sol 'Q23 CDS' a -> Q23a, b (regression) -> Q23c; sol 'Q24 CD' a -> Q34a, b (median) -> Q34c. No printed solutions for Q11-17, 19, 21, 22, 23b, 25-33, 34b, and no independence reasoning for Q24b. Printed error in the guidelines: sol Q5 (paper Q3) writes cosec(pi+theta)=1/sin(pi+theta)=1/sin(theta), which is wrong (sin(pi+theta) = -sin(theta)); the printed key A (-1/sin theta) is correct, so the key was kept; working transcribed as printed and needs a fix. Guideline for Q23c uses D and M for the variables. Q31(d) says 'the balls' as printed. Q13 (box plots/outliers) and Q23 (bivariate data) flagged standard_topic. Figures for Q26a, Q27b, Q29a, Q31e, Q25 second graph are blank answer grids/axes. Q30 figure crop excludes the printed formula h(t), which is in the stem text.
